name: Ostrom’s analysis of common-pool governance
description: Elinor Ostrom compared institutional arrangements for common-pool resources and described recurring design principles in enduring cases.

events.statement: Ostrom published Governing the Commons with an analysis of institutions for collective action.
events.scope: The principles are analytical generalizations, not guarantees or a universal governance blueprint; communities had governed resources long before this book.
